changes: All five fines now split 90% to the shared pot / 10% off your own balance directly, floored at zero so a low balance just collects less rather than going into debt. Amounts also reduced across the board, and the 'under .22' fine is now a token amount instead of a full penalty — playing it safe isn't the same as not showing up.

New: Clean Record Bonus — a rolling monthly prize (starting at 15,000 XP) for zero fines of any kind in a full calendar month, paid to one random qualifying member. Nobody clean? It rolls over and grows for next month.
